verdicts.reason: A puts the CTA first at the far left, jammed against the canvas edge, so the reading order runs backwards. Its legal text is set as large as the subhead and competes with it, and the 'Longest Day Sale' ribbon is shrunk to an illegible sticker crammed against the end of the subhead. B reads correctly from logo to product to headline to CTA and keeps the legal text subordinate. Its flaws: the CTA is crammed against the right edge and nearly touches the end of the subhead ('June 21.'), the sale ribbon is tiny and squeezed under the legal line, and there is a dead gap between the bottle and the headline.
